responsibility: Provides the SysV/ELF ABI customization layer for IA-64, overriding generic ELF defaults with IA-64-specific assembler syntax, debugging conventions, local BSS handling, label formatting, function .proc/.endp output, relocation hooks, and type definitions. It is the main non-OS-specific Unix ABI header that adapts GCC’s generic elfos support to the IA-64 SysV object format and toolchain expectations.
